purpose: Issue #53 - the honest connection register for evidence providers. A provider listed here is NOT automatically connected. connection_state is the only field that decides whether this repository can obtain evidence from it without a human, and nothing in acquisition/signal-intelligence/ ever changes that field on its own.

connection_states.REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE: The evidence already lives in this repository and can be read offline with no credential and no network call.
connection_states.MANUAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY: A real external account exists on the owner side, but this repository has no connection to it. Evidence enters only when the owner records it into a repository file. No automation is claimed.
connection_states.CONTRACT_ONLY: The contract is implemented and testable, but no connection, credential, quota or terms review exists. This provider currently supplies zero evidence records.
connection_states.BLOCKED: Must not be used as an automated evidence provider.

repository_records.notes: Durable operator-recorded evidence. Every record sourced here cites the exact file and key it was read from.

owner_source_material.notes: Completed owner-approved source packages. content/note-publish-queue/README.md defines what COMPLETE means; drafts are not COMPLETE.

x_public_posts.manual_step: The owner reads public posts on X and records the observation into acquisition/signal-intelligence/observations/. This repository holds no X API credential, runs no crawler, and cannot obtain a post on its own.
x_public_posts.notes: MANUAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY is the honest state: real observations by a real person, recorded into a repository file. It is not an API connection. Where a post_url or account is not recorded, it stays UNRECORDED - no identifier is ever generated to fill the gap.

posthog.manual_step: One-time owner action: add a read-only PostHog project API key as a GitHub Actions secret and add a query step. Until then, owned analytics reach this layer only through revenue-os/metrics.json entries the owner writes.
posthog.notes: revenue-os/metrics.json distribution_baseline_2026_08_27 cites PostHog project 573335. That is an owner-recorded observation, not a live connection from this repository.

stripe.manual_step: One-time owner action: expose a read-only Stripe key to CI if automated purchase evidence is wanted. Purchase counts remain unusable without a payment-provider record either way.
stripe.notes: revenue-os/metrics.json records stripe_live_payment_intents: 0 as of 2026-08-24. That is a measured zero, not a missing measurement.

payhip.manual_step: Owner-side export of Payhip order records when a purchase occurs.

gumroad.manual_step: Owner-side export of Gumroad sales records when a purchase occurs.

reddit.manual_step: No connection. distribution/provider-policy.json marks reddit community-only-deferred with publishingEnabled false. Reading would additionally require an approved API application and rate-limit terms review.
reddit.notes: Zero evidence records today. The contract exists so a corroborating PAIN_SIGNAL can be ingested the moment it is legitimately obtained.

product_hunt.manual_step: No connection. Would require a Product Hunt API token and terms review.

google_trends.manual_step: No connection. There is no official public API; any access route needs an explicit terms review before use.

youtube_search_trends.manual_step: No connection. Would require a YouTube Data API key and quota.
youtube_search_trends.notes: Zero evidence records today. Shares the trends independence group with google_trends, so the two cannot corroborate each other.

software_reviews.manual_step: No connection. G2 / Capterra / GetApp / Software Advice each require a licensed data route; scraping is not an option.

question_demand.manual_step: No connection. Would require a paid question-demand tool account.

competitor_pricing_pages.manual_step: No connection. Public pricing pages may be read by a human and recorded; no automated crawler is authorised here.
